derivatives.derivation: Saved first60 result points at motion_first60.mp4; 1799 frames at 29.97 Hz, 640x360, versus full source 12867 frames at 1920x1080. Treat as same recording despite re-encoding and distinct hash.

references.ubfc_convention: Rows: raw contact PPG, device HR, timestamps. 1547 columns; duplicate timestamp merged by mean ->1546 times. Preserve existing relative dataset origin and nominal center +/-5 s arithmetic device-HR mean with endpoint coverage; do not align by peak-error fitting.
references.data1_convention: Preserve video_start_utc_ns=1788939171166718500 and shifts [-5,-2,-1,0,1,2,5]. int64 subtraction before seconds; finite positive notification mean in nominal half-open center +/-5 s window; >=2 values, selected internal gaps <=2 s; no independent re-zeroing.
references.synthetic_convention: Known generator frequency 72 bpm; no PPG waveform morphology truth supplied.
references.reference_quality_warning: Calculable reference and available files do not independently establish sensor physiological accuracy or hardware synchronization.

cache_audit.identity_rules: V2.1 --cache requires exact resolved video path, bytes, mtime_ns, max_seconds, and frontend_hashes for motion_frontend.py/legacy_motion.py/analyze_rppg.py; additionally SHA256 of trace and frame count must match.
cache_audit.what_is_saved: Frame-level ROI RGB statistics, validity/quality, face boxes/source/motion and detection flags; not original pixel distributions.
cache_audit.what_can_be_reused: Frozen V2.1 output/evaluation can serve as old baseline. Exact same frontend may reuse validated trace. V22 gap0.15 may reuse freshly extracted V22 gap0.10 trace if video/frontend identity and trace hash match.
cache_audit.what_cannot_be_reused: V22 trimmed-mean RGB differs from V2.1 patch medians. Do not feed old V2.1 RGB trace as if re-extracted with trimmed mean, and do not edit metadata to bypass frontend identity. Read the original frames for new sampling.

next_version_evaluation_checklist.detail: Six source groups, old V21 and both V22 modes (trimmed_gap10 and trimmed_gap15), identical detector/ROI definitions, declared trim10%, exact frame/window grids. No per-video best-mode or best-time-shift selection.

UBFC paired dataset-reference regression; data1 estimated synchronization primary0 plus all7 shifts; three no-reference recordings get NA accuracy; synthetic72 engineering-frequency check. No pooled claim that treats these categories as one clinical sample.

Report local and offline DP; Nplanned/Nref/Noutput/Nvalid, Cout/Cref, MAE/RMSE/Bias/descriptive LoA, P5 and full-reference R5. Include strict common-output windows and added/lost windows with separate errors and counts.

Count rejected windows and output run breaks; report longest consecutive HR run using first/last center span and explicitly labeled union of actual frame support. Do not sum 10s overlapping windows as independent time.

Compare old/new face_detected, flow_available, source and rgb_valid masks. Separately report generated versus neighbor-covered waveform windows, finite waveform sample duration and longest finite run, interpolation fraction/gap limits. Detection success/output coverage is not accuracy.
Saved base, periodic Hann full window, nfft8192, .7–3.5Hz, device/known reference H1±.1Hz; own/common and paired deltas. No morphology-r claim without validated timing/site waveform reference.

Re-extract trimmed-mean traces from all6 original sources; second gap mode reuses only matching new trace. Freeze hashes, compare all12 new runs to old baseline, preserve old results. No renamed duplicate/re-encode/clip counts as a new recording.

Next independent validation needs prospectively synchronized camera and ECG/contact reference with shared hardware/visible trigger and recorded clock mapping, across new sessions/subjects and movement types. Current six groups have all already been inspected; this is a future measurement requirement, not a request to restore deleted data.
